claim: In the feature availability by resource table, Amazon EKS has check marks for cross-Region backup, cross-account backup, full management, item-level restore and logically air-gapped vault, and no check mark for AWS Backup Audit Manager, incremental backup, continuous backup and point-in-time restore, lifecycle to cold storage, restore testing, backup search, backup tiering, malware protection or access points.
question: Which AWS Backup features does Amazon EKS support?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon EKS in the feature availability by resource table
qualifiers.condition: a blank cell means no check mark in the table
